item.title: 智能体安全：企业三分之二强制执行智能体权限，不到五分之一隔离高风险智能体
item.summary: Across 116 enterprises, agents are in production and so are the incidents: A majority have already had a confirmed agent security event or a near-miss. Two-thirds of enterprises enforce scoped permissions at runtime. Barely one in five isolates its highest-risk agents, making containment the weakest layer in the stack
